concept.title: Planning releases
concept.shortdesc: Choose Add release and give the release a name, and if you like a target date, a status and a description. A new release goes at the end of the list. Each name is used once per project.

conbody.p: Releases run in the order of the list: use the arrows beside a release to move it earlier or later. The order matters, because a requirement planned for one release is in every later release too.
A release's status is Planned, In progress or Released. Marking a release released records the day it shipped, and its burn-up stops there.
You can't delete a release that requirements still target: move them to another release first, or clear their release, then delete it.
